subject: Review+land mac/session-expiry-hardening: row 58 closed (relocated fail-open) + the missing isExpired test
body: Branch mac/session-expiry-hardening (80e21884) is CI-green and ready for your review/land like #385. TWO things in it. (1) The BUILD_BACKLOG item you filed - isExpired/ExpiryPolicy had NO test, a wrong-logic edit would pass every gate - is closed: EnterpriseShellTests/SessionExpiryTests.swift, 6 cases, falsified against the old .nonExpiring:return false (the two blank-justification cases go red, rest green). (2) Adding the test surfaced that row 58 was NOT fully closed by the ExpiryPolicy type change - it MOVED. ExpiryPolicy removes the in-code unknown-expiry case, but SessionData is Codable and KeychainService.getSession restores it via JSONDecoder().decode(SessionData.self,...), so a tampered/malformed blob decodes cleanly to .nonExpiring(justification:"") - the ignorance case relocated into persistence, granting a permanently non-expired session, and isExpired feeds the Assist gate's stale input. Hardened: a .nonExpiring whose justification is blank/whitespace reads as EXPIRED (the sole in-code producer, IdentityProvider MDM branch, always states a full reason). SessionData.swift wired into BOTH the Xcode test target and the SwiftPM port (Foundation-only, same file both builds). Verified: swift test 63/0, xcodebuild TEST SUCCEEDED 63/0, check-ios-dynamic-type + check-ios-dead-stored-properties OK, preflight PASSED, breadth 56/0. Note for the plan doc: COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN line ~2157 'row 58 confirmed still live' is now stale - closed by this branch; reconcile it on land (I left the big canonical doc to you to avoid a figure-gate surprise). Sites 2/3 (SessionStateManager checkSessionTimeout/validateActiveSession) are correct-by-type, not fail-opens: nil expiresAt now only means .nonExpiring, a deliberate MDM state.
